entries.name: Catherine Melville

expected.charges: Malicious destruction of property and unlawful entry (the March 22, 1969 raid on Dow Chemical's Washington, DC offices).
expected.sentence: Verdict as recorded: Convicted; most convictions reversed on appeal in 1972.

updates.plead: Nolo contendere to one count of malicious destruction of property
updates.sentence: Held in pretrial custody following the March 22, 1969 Dow Chemical protest. The contemporary Washington Free Press identifies all nine defendants as jailed and fasting, with bond set at $1,000. The actual release date remains unresolved. Later entered a no-contest plea to one property-destruction count; the other charges were dismissed. This defendant was not among the seven appellants whose convictions were reversed in 1972.

entries.rationale: Contemporary Washington Free Press individually identifies all nine and their pretrial incarceration. Appellate opinion distinguishes these two no-contest defendants from the seven appellants. No release assigned from anticipated April 2-7 bail window or appeal decision.
